summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Siempria Conteo app after frontend refactoring and heatmap_profile automation feature. All 12 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend views load correctly after refactoring from monolithic App.js to modular components under /app/frontend/src/conteo/.

issues: Presentation Mode uses position:fixed and z-index:1000 which overlays the entire screen including navigation tabs. When in Presentation mode, users need to use force=True click or exit presentation mode first before navigating to other tabs. Consider adding an exit button or ESC key handler.
